en: Color image showing a hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring two tall spires and several smaller spires, attached to a castle-like ensemble with red-tiled roofs. The complex rises above a river, with wooded slopes and lower houses along the waterfront. In the foreground there is a grassy riverbank and a wooden balustrade, with leafy trees framing the view under a bright blue sky.
